Metadata.description: Learn to hear familiar English words in real speech with Murad, an English teacher. Follow his 90-day YouTube challenge and discover upcoming listening tools.

Home.title: Hear the English you already know.
Home.lead: I’m Murad, an English teacher. I help learners recognize familiar words in real speech, across accents and speaking speeds.

puzzle.title: Phonetic Puzzle
puzzle.body: Hear one word pronounced by different speakers, then recognize it in fast speech.

player.title: 3-Step Listening Player
player.body: Watch with subtitles, explore the words and grammar, then listen again as an audio playlist.

matcher.title: Level & Interest Matcher
matcher.body: Find videos, podcasts and interviews that fit a learning level and personal interests.

quizzer.title: Active Listening Quizzer
quizzer.body: Practice with questions, missing words and dictation based on a video.
